answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation is an important and challenging task in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP)... We conduct experiments on two benchmarks of paraphrasing tasks: Parabank and Quora datasets.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the paraphrasing models from the following aspects: (1) Fidelity... (2) Diversity... (3) Fluency... To evaluate the fidelity automatically, we use BertScore... To evaluate the diversity automatically, we calculate "Self-BLEU"...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct the human evaluation to evaluate the quality of generated paraphrases of each model. Concretely, we randomly sample 100 test instances... ask volunteers to score the outputs from the following aspects: (1) Fidelity, (2) Diversity, and (3) Fluency. The scores range from 1-5, with 5 being the best. We guarantee that each instance is scored by at least 3 human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated paraphrase on fidelity, diversity, and fluency using a 1-5 Likert scale.
